title: The finish-gate standard names no KRN-only script
body:
Why: c6e6b03 widened s-finish-gate to grep -qE 'krn hook stop|worker-stop' .claude/settings.json; worker-stop is a KRN script name inside a universal record, and any settings text containing the word passes.
Outcome: the universal record recognises an adopted Stop hook by a stack-neutral marker (e.g. a Stop hook entry whose command exits non-zero on red tests, or krn hook stop), and KRN carries its own worker-stop variant as a project record in .agents/standards.json.
Proof: standards test: a settings file mentioning worker-stop outside a Stop hook fails the record; KRN and a freshly adopted repo pass.
